scenarios.name: Real signed source evidence commits checkpoint in disposable SQL
New application Pool and verifier reject older signed versions
Forged, missing and timed-out sources never write checkpoint
Governance key rotation requires old-key revocation and higher revision
Same-version signed evidence conflict and three-domain causal mismatch deny
Precommit failure rolls back signed evidence; clean retry succeeds
Competing signed views of same-version evidence cannot both commit
PostgreSQL RLS blocks signed source from writing a different tenant
V3.2-101 facade reads actual signed+SQL watermark and never grants authorization

trust_limits: All keys are ephemeral fixture-generated Ed25519 keys, not finance/academic production signatories
PostgreSQL is a disposable CI service; no real KMS, IAM, durable production trust root, enterprise replication or server crash recovery
Source readers and positive V3.2-101 downstream adapters use synthetic test data
PostgreSQL checkpoint stores a monotonically versioned audit record; it does not authenticate business facts
Source fence double-read plus SQL commit is not cross-system atomic handoff, and has a possible source-update-after-read race
Database roles can update only audit checkpoints, never protected payment or lesson records
Real account attribution, family linking and business contract UAT are not tested by this module
